Враќањето ќе го изведеме по истата патека.
Ден 2: За сите што сакаат да покачат адреналин и да се пробаат на ферата ќе искачуваме некоја од фератите во Печ.

Hajla from Kosovo and a beginner via ferrata 5-6.09.2026

⛰️Activity description: This weekend we are taking you to the highest peak in the northern part of Prokletije, Mount Hajla (2403 m a.s.l.), with the summit of the same name located right on the border between Kosovo and Montenegro. Sunday is the day for climbing a via ferrata in Peja.

👣 Trail description: 
Day 1: Ascent of Hajla. We start from the locality of Rekë e Allagës (1400 m a.s.l.), located about 20 kilometers northwest of Peja, Kosovo. After leaving the forest, for the next 2 km we continue north, climbing the ridge to 2300 m a.s.l., from where we continue to the summit of Hajla. We return along the same trail.
Day 2: For everyone who wants to raise the adrenaline and try a via ferrata, we will climb one of the via ferratas in Peja.

36th Traditional Ascent of Korab 2764m on the occasion of North Macedonia's Independence Day.

HIKING PROGRAM: (06.09.2026 Sunday) 
- Departure from Skopje Railway Station - Post Office 2 at 05:00.
- Departure is on time; we are not responsible for those who are late. 
- Arrival 2 km before the Strezimir watchtower at an altitude of 1500 meters.
- Ascent of Golem Korab 2764 meters
- Return to Skopje

TOUR DESCRIPTION:
- From the starting point to the summit we have an elevation gain of 1490 meters.
- One way is 10 km, 20 km round trip. +2 km from the bus to the watchtower, which adds +4 km round trip.
- In the first part of the tour there is water for refilling (one spring), after that there is none
- The tour falls into the difficult category, but because of the long day and the group moving together, it is easier to complete.

RECOMMENDATIONS:
- Do not load your backpacks with too much food
- There will be enough breaks so everyone can reach the summit
- According to the organizer, the ascent starts at 09:00 and the summit closes at 15:00, so wherever someone is at 15:00, as a rule they should descend toward the watchtower.
- The organized Korab ascent includes organized transport; our recommendation is to save your car and come with our transport.
- Bring something with long sleeves for the summit. 

REGISTRATION AND PAYMENT:
The price is 1200 den per person for organized transport from Skopje, Tetovo, Mavrovi Anovi, etc.; registration and payment no later than September 4 at 14:00 or until all places are filled.
Everyone is required to pay the Mavrovo National Park entrance fee on site, which is 100 den per person, at the checkpoint after crossing the river.

Description of the event: We invite you to a hike to Dupnat Kamen (1854 m a.s.l.) on Shar Planina, on Sunday 27.9.2026

📏Trail length: 16 km (out and back on the same trail)

📈Elevation gain: 1200 m D+

🏔️Trail description: from the parking lot at Tetovo Fortress we head towards the village of Lavce (around 900 m a.s.l.), from where the old shepherds' road continues up to the heights. The final section runs along rocky cliffs to Dupnat Kamen (1854 m a.s.l.), a natural rock gate from which the surrounding higher peaks of Shar Planina can be seen. - Патеката поминува низ нискостеблеста шума, смреки и се оди по сртот на самата планина. Водич Борис ни спреми патека за лесно поминување на целат траса долж трансферзалата Саммиана.

Патеката е во еден правец, не оставаат возилата и не земаат горе од планината. Не се враќаме назад.

After a long time, Montenegro is once again on the repertoire of hikers from Macedonia! We will go to enjoy the beautiful Dinaric Alps, with the peaks North Peak of Karanfili and Maja Jezerce as the highest peak of Prokletije. Along the way we will visit the lakes The Eye and Plav and will enjoy the food they have there, besides the clean air and the beautiful views.

PROGRAM:
10.10.2026
- Departure from Skopje, Skopje Railway Station at Pošta 2 at 05:00 *possibly earlier
- Arrival in Montenegro – ascent of Maja Karanfili
11.10

12.10
- Enjoying Lake Plav and indulging in hedonism, return to Skopje

TRAIL DESCRIPTION
- The trail to the North Peak of Karanfili 2460m is steep, you pass a lot of scree and rocks; in some places there is a cable where you climb a few meters up rock holding on with your hands. At the end the trail climbs toward the peak with a steeper incline; it is not suitable for anyone who is afraid of heights.
The views are wow!

**Karanfili 3.5km one way with 1055m – moderately difficult hike but very short

- Maja Jezerce is a long trail with mixed terrain, mostly rocks. It is long to walk, so we can also bring in a jeep which will shorten it by 6km one way from the direct road all the way to the Zastan guard post.
Maja Jezerce 2694m
With jeep - 8km one way, meaning a total of 16km of walking and 1461m elevation difference, moderately difficult hike.

MODERATELY EASY HIKING TOUR: Dlabochica Waterfall!

Our club is joining the Traditional climb of ZPZP "Kozjak 2013" - on the occasion of 11 October, the day of the uprising!

TRAIL DESCRIPTION: (from the organizer)
The trail is circular, 15.5 km long with 600 m of elevation.
The trail starts from the Preslap pass, located just below Peren peak. First we move along a wide dirt road that leads past the peak itself, and later the route turns into a hiking trail along which we descend all the way to the picturesque Mala Reka and the authentic mountain village of Dlabochica. From the village, the movement continues along a wide cart road that leads us directly to our final goal – the beautiful Dlabochica Waterfall. After the break and enjoying ourselves at the waterfall, we return back towards the mountain hut in the village of Dlabochica, and from there, via the locality "Vikendici", the trail makes a complete circle that brings us back to the starting point at the Preslap pass.
There is no water source along the trail.

PROGRAM:
- Departure from the Skopje railway station – Pošta 2 at 06:00
- Arrival at the drop-off point at 07:40

*Peren peak is the highest peak of the Kozjak (Kozjačica) mountain
- Arrival at the Dlabochica Waterfall, rest
- Back, rest and enjoying the trail among the trees
- Return towards Skopje and visit to the observatory (optional)

⛰️Description of the event: For the holiday we climb peaks of BISTRA, Ḱurkov Dol (2141 m a.s.l.) and Golem Brzovec (2085 m a.s.l.). Bistra is one of those mountains that are massive in relief but without a pronounced ridge. On that plateau of peaks, the central part is dominated by Ḱurkov Dol, a less visited peak compared to the western parts of the mountain.

👣Description of the trail: We leave the asphalt road towards the village of Galičnik at Carevec (1814 m a.s.l.), along a dirt road (6 km) towards Ḱurkov Dol. Then along a hiking trail we climb to Ḱurkov Dol, from where we continue towards Golem Brzovec and finish the loop tour at the starting point.

💪Effort: Easy event, suitable for beginners.

📏Trail length: 12 km in total

📈Elevation gain: 700m D+

⏱️Duration of the event (total): 6-8 hours

Starting point: the slopes of Bistra, near the ski slopes (1680 m a.s.l.)

• High hiking boots
• Trekking poles
• Clothing appropriate for the weather
• Sunglasses, sunscreen

🎀 TITOV VRV WITH A RIBBON 2026
Together we are stronger!

This October, Jasmina and Sibel, with the support of I Love Hiking, are once again calling you to the mountain, this time with an important message.

In the month dedicated to raising awareness of breast cancer, together we will climb Titov Vrv (2,747 m) and through our joint hiking event we will send a message about prevention, early detection and care for women's health. 🎀

EVENT DETAILS

Destination: Titov Vrv, Šar Planina
Altitude: 2,747 m
Trail length: 21 km
Elevation gain: 1,050 m D+
Difficulty: moderately difficult
Expected duration: 10–12 hours
TRAIL
The event starts from Hotel "Konak" at Popova Šapka (1,700 m)

From the starting point we move along the summer "Vakavska" trail, via which we climb towards the highest peak of Šar Planina — Titov Vrv (2,747 m).

The return is along the same trail to Popova Šapka.

The trail is long and requires good physical fitness. Participants need to be able to endure 10–12 hours of movement in the mountains.

MANDATORY EQUIPMENT
Hiking boots
Hiking socks
Clothing appropriate for the weather conditions (layered clothing, suitable for both warm and cold weather)
Hat
Gloves
Waterproof jacket / protection from rain and wind
Long hiking trousers
Headlamp
Sunglasses
Sunscreen
At least 2 liters of water
Food (sandwiches, nuts and dried fruit...)
Trekking poles
